component: reconciliation-PDE version selection and post-reconciliation adjustment documentation treatment

prior_component_context_not_new_closure.location: printed page 36; PDF file page 39; Appendix A
prior_component_context_not_new_closure.context: The CY2022 reconciliation deadline was June 29, 2023, and sampled PDE records were submitted on or before that date.
prior_component_context_not_new_closure.prior_pulse_context: Pulse 43 already used the cutoff and sampled reconciliation-PDE frame as measurement-object context.

prior_component_context_not_new_closure.location: printed page 36; PDF file page 39; Appendix A
prior_component_context_not_new_closure.context: The CY2022 Part D IPM validates the PDE that the sponsor determined was final for CY2022 Part D Payment Reconciliation.
prior_component_context_not_new_closure.prior_pulse_context: Pulses 39 and 43 already established the reconciliation PDE as the aligned documentation and review target.

new_two_track_after_adjustment_treatment.trigger: The sponsor adjusted a sampled reconciliation PDE after June 29, 2023.
new_two_track_after_adjustment_treatment.track_one_reconciliation_pde_documentati: The sponsor must still submit documentation aligned to the PDE submitted to CMS as the RECON PDE, matching the sampled reconciliation-PDE identifiers and specified fields.
new_two_track_after_adjustment_treatment.track_two_linked_adjustment_documentatio: The sponsor must also submit additional documentation indicating that the sampled PDE was adjusted after reconciliation, linked to the adjusted PDE when it supports intended reconciliation-PDE fields.
new_two_track_after_adjustment_treatment.location: printed page 36; PDF file page 39; Appendix A
new_two_track_after_adjustment_treatment.closure_boundary: Only the two-track documentation requirement after an adjustment is newly closed by this pulse.

supporting_operational_detail.missing_reconciliation_pde_documentation: If the sponsor cannot locate documentation for the sampled reconciliation PDE, the guide directs it to upload a Missing Documentation Form for each missing document.
supporting_operational_detail.claim_detail_file_alignment: Claim Detail File data must match the reconciliation PDE in the supplied identifier fields.
supporting_operational_detail.interpretation: These are operational submission requirements; they do not disclose inclusion, exclusion, denominator, weighting, estimator, or payment effects.

closed_component_scope: After a sampled reconciliation PDE is adjusted following reconciliation, documentation aligned to the sampled reconciliation PDE remains required.
The sponsor must separately provide linked documentation showing the post-reconciliation adjustment.
The two documentation tracks coexist; later adjustment documentation does not replace reconciliation-PDE-aligned documentation.
unsupported_or_missing_components: whether an adjusted sampled PDE is included in or excluded from the national estimate
whether an adjustment changes the unit's error classification or corrected Gross Drug Cost
treatment of adjustments in the $96,521.39 million denominator or any payment-stream taxonomy
treatment of negative adjustments, reversals, deletions, rejected PDEs, duplicates, replacements, or post-cutoff changes beyond the documented case
sample-weight, projection-factor, replacement, nonresponse, aggregation, variance, or confidence-limit effects
relationship of adjusted sampled PDEs to beneficiary simulation, federal outlays, settlement, or payment reconciliation amounts
counts of adjusted sampled PDEs and their aggregate dollar or rate effect
complete included and excluded payment streams, plan types, contracts, populations, subsidy components, and payment phases
interpretation_boundaries: The June 29, 2023 cutoff and final reconciliation-PDE review target are prior Pulse 39 and Pulse 43 context, not new closures in this pulse.
A documentation requirement does not establish whether a record is included, excluded, replaced, reweighted, or assigned an error in the estimator.
The adjusted PDE does not replace the sampled reconciliation PDE as the documented review target under Appendix A.
A Missing Documentation Form submission path is not proof that a record is excluded from or retained in the estimator.
The sampled reconciliation-PDE object is not the complete Part D payment universe or the federal-outlay denominator.
No payment effect, debt, collectibility, recovery, fraud, waste, prevention, or savings claim follows from the two-track documentation rule.

field_review.remaining_need: A same-period authoritative payment-universe and estimator specification defining included and excluded streams; adjustment, reversal, deletion, duplicate, replacement, eligibility, settlement, and denominator treatment; GDC-to-federal-outlay mapping; and sample-weight, projection, simulation, and variance effects.
